questions.q: How is an Awareness campaign measured?
options: Low CPC and assisted conversions in the 7-day window
Reach, frequency and estimated ad recall lift
ROAS compared against the industry benchmark
Cost per lead compared against the historical average
questions.explanation: Awareness doesn't optimize clicks or sales: it's evaluated with reach, frequency and estimated recall. Judging it by CPC is a measurement error.

options: Which touchpoint of the journey gets credit for the sale?
Which CPM is competitive for the business category?
How many conversions would NOT have happened without the ads?
Which creative drives the highest CTR per surface?
questions.explanation: Incrementality = causality: how much value the ads generated that wouldn't have existed without them. Credit per touchpoint is attribution.

questions.q: To measure changes in recall and purchase intent for a brand campaign:
options: Conversion Lift with a holdout group
Brand Lift with surveys of exposed vs control groups
An A/B test of creatives with cost-per-result metrics
MMM with aggregated data from all business channels
questions.explanation: Brand Lift surveys exposed and non-exposed people to measure recall, awareness and intent. Conversion Lift measures incremental sales, not perception.

questions.q: Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is used for:
options: The daily tactical optimization of campaigns and ad sets
Approving ads from sensitive categories before the ad review process
Building custom audiences with TV and radio data
Seeing the aggregate impact of every on/offline channel at a macro level
questions.explanation: MMM is the macro layer: it models how each channel (Meta, TV, search, offline) contributes to the business at an aggregate/annual level.

options: Changes the real sales the business records
Changes which conversions are credited to Meta, without changing real sales
Disables the Pixel signal until the next synchronization of the dataset
Converts the results to a last-click model
questions.explanation: The window defines which conversions count in the report. It moves the reported number, never the sales that actually happened.

questions.q: Leadership doubts: 'wouldn't those sales have happened anyway without ads?' What do you propose?
options: A 7-day click attribution report to prove it
Brand Lift to measure current purchase intent
Conversion Lift with a holdout group: it measures real causality
Raising the frequency and comparing the following weeks' results
questions.explanation: The question is causal and attribution doesn't prove causality. Conversion Lift compares exposed vs holdout: true incremental sales.

questions.q: The correct role of attribution in a mature measurement plan:
options: It's the single, sufficient proof that the ads caused the reported sales
It guides daily tactical optimization; causality is proven by experiments
It replaces MMM whenever offline channels exist
It's only reliable if the window is 28-day click
questions.explanation: Each tool has its role: attribution for day-to-day decisions, experiments (lift) for causality, MMM for the macro view.

options: Likes and impressions look good but don't prove business-goal progress
Likes and shares predict future sales better than the reported ROAS
Impressions are the key metric for the Sales objective
CTR is the final verdict for any campaign
questions.explanation: Vanity metrics (likes, loose impressions) impress but don't answer the business goal. Report them as context, not as the verdict.

options: Experiments (lift) + attribution + MMM read together
Three attribution windows compared against each other
Three ad platforms running the same creative
Brand Lift run three times during the quarter
questions.explanation: Triangulating = joining the three layers: experiments for causality, attribution for tactics and MMM for the macro view. A single lens misleads.

questions.q: An Awareness campaign reports high CPC and leadership wants it 'fixed'. What do you do?
options: Switch to Traffic so the CPC drops immediately
Raise the bid to win better auction positions and bring the CPC down
Explain that CPC isn't an Awareness metric; it's evaluated on recall and reach
Pause the campaign until a better creative is produced
questions.explanation: Awareness doesn't optimize clicks: CPC is irrelevant for that objective. Switching to Traffic would abandon the rebrand's business goal.
